original_card.question: Can one misleading historical-current claim or missing research cross-reference be corrected?
methods: Trace one confusing path from onboarding to its authoritative source.
Index one tightly related family of obstructions with explicit excluded and open hypotheses.
original_card.acceptance_gate: Produce evidence-backed navigation, preserve historical records and avoid a duplicate global survey.

scope_change_reason: PR1159 already links PR1135, so a navigation-only edit would add little. The claimed task adds an executable applicability comparison and a finite rational construction to reconcile the representation hypotheses. This is explicitly broader than the original pure navigation card.
actual_scope: Consolidate PR1057/1135/1159 exact representation contracts using an odd-denominator, integral-output rational comparison, full source pins, least actual prefix denominator and a paid preparation/kernel invoice.
bottleneck_link: This identifies one possible precision representation for exact additive boundaries. It does not change paid supplier profiles or supply rounded/physical interfaces, so no kappa gain follows.
stop_rule: One frozen 52-factor comparison and declared small cases; no broad rational reconstruction or rounded-supplier search.
evidence: README.md, PROOF.md, CASE.json.gz, EXPECTED.json and the two explicit replay commands.
author: Gareth Davidson (@bitplane)
ai_assistance: Substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; no subagents or independent human review.

open_questions.question: Does a useful exact segment of a named selected supplier satisfy the odd-denominator and integral-boundary contract?
open_questions.why_it_matters: This decides whether the representation comparison can help an actual supplier, rather than only the dense example.
open_questions.first_step: Extract the rational coefficients of PR1094's retained scalar A segment, record their reduced denominator valuations at two, and check its exact boundary on formal columns before any optimization.
open_questions.blocked_by: Even denominators, rounded or irrational leaves, or nonintegral required intermediate boundaries need another interface; physical admission and full paid costs remain required.

open_questions.question: Can a structured integrality certificate be checked with less online cost and workspace than forming the complete rational matrix product?
open_questions.why_it_matters: Generic admission can offset data-space benefits and adds temporary matrix storage.
open_questions.first_step: Emit and price a certificate for the central-scaling family using integer base matrices and a unit product of scales, including descriptor reads and normalization.
open_questions.blocked_by: No generic cheap integrality certificate is provided; changing preprocessing assumptions cannot be counted as a free runtime improvement.
